title: Timeline DHIS2
description: DHIS2 tracker data for the timeline: query hooks for a person's history across programs, with names resolved, and presentational event, change, note and milestone entry parts.
docs: useTrackedEntityHistory({ trackedEntity, timeField }) returns entries, status, notices and refetch for every program the person is enrolled in (or programs you pass). Render each entry with TimelineHistoryEntry, or compose TimelineEventEntry and its parts; add host actions with eventActions and useTimelineEventEntry(). Invalidate timelineKeys.root to refresh after edits elsewhere.
